title: feat(011meet12): (0,1,1) B6-union still meets at (1,0,0) t=1; worse var than l1
science: Host-size robustness repeat of #6742 on the larger union B_6(0) u B_6((2,0,0)) (523 sites): the two-seed negative holds -- var_l1 = 0.008180 < var_(0,1,1) = 0.009283 on their respective midplanes (61 vs 69 sites), first meeting still the singleton {(1,0,0)} at t=1. Confirms the two-seed isotropy loss is not a small-host artifact; no new mechanism.
